title: 7-day Burst Fragmentation Index — cluster & pool rollup
content:
Scope: 7-day aggregate (2026-07-23 -> 2026-07-29) of GPU utilization and a derived 'Fragmentation Index' used to estimate microburst risk and effective headroom across clusters and pools. This export is intended for capacity planners and on-call SREs to prioritize defragmentation, reservation changes, and short-term capacity buys.

Summary table (CSV rows):
cluster,pool,region,avg_util_pct,p95_util_pct,tail_latency_ms,headroom_pct,fragmentation_index,burst_risk_score
cluster-alpha,high-throughput,us-west1,67.3,92.1,185,12.7,0.18,0.78
cluster-alpha,general-purpose,us-west1,48.9,76.0,142,31.2,0.22,0.46
cluster-beta,reserved,us-east1,81.5,98.7,265,4.5,0.05,0.96
cluster-beta,general-purpose,us-east1,54.1,83.4,198,20.3,0.26,0.61
cluster-gamma,high-throughput,eu-west1,72.0,95.6,212,9.2,0.14,0.82
cluster-delta,burstable,asia-southeast1,39.7,65.2,115,44.8,0.34,0.28
fleet-total,all,global,60.5,87.9,187,20.1,0.20,0.65

Metric definitions (short):
- avg_util_pct: weighted mean of GPU utilization over the window.
- p95_util_pct: 95th percentile of sampled per-minute utilization.
- tail_latency_ms: 99th-percentile inference tail latency observed (ms) for token generation endpoints routed to cluster/pool.
- headroom_pct: theoretical spare GPU capacity under current packing (1 - avg_util adjusted for reservations).
- fragmentation_index: fraction of GPU slices that are idle but not reassignable without migration (0..1). Higher = worse.
- burst_risk_score: composite 0..1 (higher = greater risk) = 0.5*norm(p95_util) + 0.3*fragmentation_index + 0.2*norm(tail_latency). Norms use fleet historical maxima.

Key observations: 
- Cluster-beta (reserved pool) shows the highest burst risk (0.96). Despite being 'reserved', p95 spikes to near 99% and tail latency breaches SLO during two short windows (07-25 14:06–14:11 UTC and 07-28 03:40–03:46 UTC). Root cause traces point to a scheduled batch rollout that overlapped an autoscaling bug (see INFRA-2748).
- Cluster-delta (asia-southeast1, burstable) has low average utilization but a high fragmentation_index (0.34) — many small, long-running low-CPU jobs are scattering GPU slices and reducing effective headroom for short-lived high-concurrency requests.
- General-purpose pools across regions show consistent fragmentation (~0.22–0.26) which increases effective cost-per-inference and raises scheduling latency under burst.

Actionable recommendations (short-term, 72h):
1) Emergency mitigations for Cluster-beta: 
   - Patch autoscaler (PR linked: GitHub:redwood-infra/auto-scale-fix/pull/17) and schedule canary rollout in a low-traffic window (target 2026-08-01 02:00–04:00 UTC).
   - Temporarily increase soft-reservation on beta-reserved by +8% (move 1 rack-equivalent from general-purpose pool) to reduce p95 overload while root cause is fixed. Estimated impact: reduce burst_risk_score from 0.96 -> ~0.78.
2) Defragmentation for asia-southeast1: run the 'slice-consolidate' job (GitHub: redwood-infra/defrag-tool) across burstable pools during maintenance window; expected fragmentation_index improvement from 0.34 -> 0.12 and headroom gain ~11%.
3) Schedule a 'packing sweep' on general-purpose pools: consolidate long-lived micro-batching infra (observed across alpha and beta) and apply tenant-affinity tags to reduce cross-tenant scattering. Estimate 6–9% fleet-wide headroom gain.

Operational notes for SRE on-call: 
- Thresholds to watch (alert tuning suggestions):
  - p95_util_pct > 92% on reserved/high-throughput pools for > 5 minutes -> Page (P1).
  - fragmentation_index > 0.30 on any pool for > 12h -> Ops review (P2).
  - burst_risk_score delta > +0.15 vs rolling-7d baseline -> Pager if coincides with latency SLO breach.

Follow-ups & longer-term items (>2 weeks):
- Implement an automated defragmentation policy: when fragmentation_index > 0.25 AND headroom_pct < 25%, trigger low-impact consolidation (off-peak only).
- Revisit reservation strategy: reserve capacity based on burst_risk_score rather than avg_util to make reservations more SLO-driven. Pilot on cluster-beta.
- Run a synthetic microburst sim (linked replay tool) to validate predicted headroom gains post-defrag.

Appendix: short extracts from raw signals (sample windows):
- 07-25 14:00–14:12 UTC (cluster-beta reserved): p95_util jumped 82% -> 98.7%, tail_latency 120ms -> 265ms; top contributors: batch-rollout-frontend (ticket INFRA-2748).
- 07-28 03:38–03:48 UTC (cluster-gamma HT): short 4-min spike with tail latency 212ms, correlated with cross-region fallback routing.

Immediate owners:

- Defrag run & pack-sweep: Maya Singh, Luca Moretti
- Capacity approval for short-term reservation bump: Priya Nair (capacity planner) + finance on-call (cc: @finance-ops)

Questions for review meeting (2026-08-02):

- Approve automated defrag trial in APAC for 2 weeks?
- Any objections to alert threshold changes above?
